obligations.name: Statement
obligations.constructed: Sections3-6 conditional on exact retained source theorems.
obligations.justification: No final global modularity conclusion is stated.

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required: Same B_C(r_x), its global point, then same fixed WD target.
obligations.constructed: Homology quotient dual, classical V_f epsilon^n, and a proved unitary nu.
obligations.justification: Section5 uses annihilator and actual envelope, not functor-image uniqueness.

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required: Minimal tame level, no vexing primes, type and weight, actual potential semistability.
obligations.constructed: Earlier accepted auxiliary2/193 construction plus published classical theorem.
obligations.justification: Only the auxiliary reduction is asserted absolutely irreducible.

obligations.name: Quantifiers
obligations.required: Every target supercuspidal parameter and pair of distinct weights.
obligations.constructed: Any constituent of a stable sigma tensor W lattice invokes the accepted all20-weight auxiliary lift.
obligations.justification: The finite inertia case split is exhaustive in dimension2.

obligations.name: Parameters
obligations.required: Finite coefficient fields and legal twists.
obligations.constructed: Finite extensions for eigenvalues, inertia splitting and a square root; unitary nu then defines a continuous Galois character.
obligations.justification: No infinite coefficient extension or discontinuous twist is consumed.

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.required: Exact Hecke, Galois, duality and type maps.
obligations.constructed: Same geometric Frobenius Hecke system, quotient-dual annihilator, removal of common W, explicit conjugation.
obligations.justification: All maps retain their direction and no multiplicity-one hypothesis is added.

obligations.name: Conventions
obligations.constructed: k=v-u+1,n=-u, epsilon=|.|x, WD(epsilon)=|.|, geometric Frobenius throughout.
obligations.justification: The algebraic dual and smooth determinant factor are both retained.

obligations.name: Exceptions
obligations.required: Do not transfer the claim to scalar types or residual branches.
obligations.constructed: Absolute WD irreducibility and distinct weights stated; special shape alternative explicitly excluded.
obligations.justification: General BM/RED/global branches are outside the conclusion.

obligations.name: Consumers
obligations.required: Current source spans and exact retained dependency boundary.
obligations.constructed: 63db830-863 and7393-7409 plus unchanged compiler002 conditional HT uses.
obligations.justification: Current TeX is still Pan/Calegari; proposal is not incorporation.
